scope: Read-only Windows hardware baseline; no installed software, settings, or game project changes.

operating_system.reliability: Registry values read successfully. ProductName and BuildLabEx may be legacy values; no Windows marketing-name assertion is made.

cpu.reliability: Model is the reported registry string; counts are current OS-exposed topology. Environment.ProcessorCount independently returned 20.

memory.reliability: OS-visible total physical memory is verified. Exact installed DIMM capacity and configuration were unavailable; 16 GiB installed is not asserted.

graphics.reliability: NVIDIA native query confirms model, VRAM, and active NVIDIA driver; registry 64-bit qwMemorySize independently matches 8 GiB. The legacy 32-bit MemorySize value was not used.

limitations: No runtime frame rate or renderer performance is inferred from hardware specifications.
Firmware-reported installed RAM capacity and DIMM details are unavailable within this sandbox.
CIM/WMI is not used; native APIs and registry provide the recorded evidence.
